topic: 数据比较与图表描述入门 · Independent new scenario: a library redesigning access to information
grammarFocus: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: Library Redesign: Comparing Access to Information
instructions: 本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何分数。先听/读对话，注意比较结构、百分比与数量表达、there was/were 和趋势动词。然后完成10道听力/阅读题，再学习语法规则并做8道语法题，最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案必须来自原文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look busy. What are you doing?
Ben: I’m looking at the library’s new plan. They want to change how people find information.
Mia: Really? What’s different?
Ben: Last year, there were only two computers near the entrance. Now there are eight. That means more people can use the internet and search for books online.
Mia: That’s a big change. What about books?
Ben: The number of printed books fell by 15 percent. But the number of e-books rose by 40 percent. So the library has fewer physical books but many more digital ones.
Mia: So more people read online?
Ben: Yes. In 2022, 30 percent of visitors used e-books. Last month, 55 percent did. That’s a big increase in digital reading.
Mia: And the quiet study area?
Ben: It’s smaller now. There were 40 desks before. Now there are 25. That’s a decrease of 15 desks.
Mia: Why?
Ben: Because more students study in groups. The group room is bigger. It went from 10 seats to 18 seats. So there’s more space for group work.
Mia: I see. Did the library buy more chairs?
Ben: Yes, but fewer than before. They bought 20 chairs last year and 12 this year.
Mia: Wait, that’s fewer? I thought they bought more.
Ben: No, fewer. Sorry, I said that wrong. They bought 12 chairs this year, not 20.
Mia: OK. So the library is changing. Is it better?
Ben: Maybe. The number of visitors increased by 8 percent. But some older people miss the printed newspapers.
Mia: Did they remove the newspapers?
Ben: Not all. There were 12 newspapers before. Now there are 5. That’s a big drop.
Mia: What about the help desk?
Ben: It’s still there, but it’s smaller. There was one large desk. Now there are two small desks.
Mia: Two small desks? That’s interesting.
Ben: Yes. And the library now has a map near the door. It shows where everything is. So it’s easier to find things.
Mia: Good. I think I’ll visit this weekend.
Ben: Me too. Let’s go together.

grammar.title: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词
grammar.explanation: 英语中比较数量变化时，常用“动词 + by + 百分比/数量”，如 rose by 40 percent（上升了40%）。表示“有”的过去式：单数用 there was，复数用 there were。趋势动词如 rise（上升）、fall（下降）、increase（增加）、decrease（减少）描述变化。比较结构常用 more/fewer + 名词，如 more chairs（更多椅子）、fewer desks（更少桌子）。注意：fewer 用于可数名词，less 用于不可数名词。
grammar.example: The number of printed books fell by 15 percent.

questions.prompt: There ______ two small desks in the office last year.
questions.explanation: 主语 two small desks 是复数，过去时用 there were。
questions.evidence: Now there are two small desks.

questions.prompt: The number of students ______ by 10 percent last year.
questions.explanation: last year 表示过去，rise 的过去式是 rose。
questions.evidence: But the number of e-books rose by 40 percent.

questions.explanation: 主语 one large desk 是单数，过去时用 there was。

questions.prompt: The library bought ______ chairs this year than last year.
questions.explanation: chairs 是可数名词复数，比较级用 fewer。
questions.evidence: They bought 12 chairs this year, not 20.

questions.explanation: 描述过去的变化，用过去式 decreased。

questions.prompt: There ______ more computers now than before.
questions.explanation: now 表示现在，computers 是复数，用 there are。

questions.prompt: The group room is ______ than the quiet study area.
questions.explanation: 比较两个区域，用比较级 bigger。

questions.prompt: The number of e-books ______ by 40 percent.
questions.explanation: 描述过去的变化，用过去式 rose。
questions.evidence: But the number of e-books rose by 40 percent.
